lines.text: Jesus says the scribes and Pharisees shut the kingdom of heaven in men's faces and make converts twice sons of hell.
Jesus says the blind guides claim swearing by the temple's silver binds a man, but the temple is greater.
Jesus says the scribes and Pharisees are like whitewashed tombs, which on the inside are full of manna.
Jesus says He longed to gather Jerusalem's children as a hen gathers her chicks, but Jerusalem was unwilling.
